mem_munbbf5w_b1a6e0494887.content: agentmemory MCP local-fallback audit fix: @agentmemory/agentmemory's standalone.mjs never wrote 'mem:audit' entries, so memory_audit was always empty. Patched the npx cache copy at C:/Users/Mateusz/AppData/Local/npm-cache/_npx/ba4b5775a0ab44e2/node_modules/@agentmemory/agentmemory/dist/standalone.mjs (added recordAudit() hooking memory_save + memory_governance_delete, newest-first sort + operation filter in memory_audit). Patched file backed up at C:/Users/Mateusz/.agentmemory/patched-standalone.mjs. REAPPLY after any npx package update: overwrite the new cache dir's dist/standalone.mjs with the backup (or re-derive the patch), then restart pi so the MCP server reloads. Verified end-to-end via MCP stdio with STANDALONE_PERSIST_PATH pointed at a temp file. Sessions (mem:sessions) remain empty by design in local fallback — they are only registered by the full server's hooks.
